```python
def serialize(method, path, canonical_authority, regular_fields, body, trailers):
    out = bytearray()
    out += method + b' ' + path + b' HTTP/1.1\r\n'
    out += b'host: ' + canonical_authority.encode('ascii') + b'\r\n'
    for name, value in regular_fields:
        out += name + b': ' + value + b'\r\n'
    if trailers is None:
        out += b'content-length: ' + str(len(body)).encode('ascii') + b'\r\n'
        out += b'\r\n'
        out += body
    else:
        out += b'transfer-encoding: chunked\r\n'
        if trailers:
            names = []
            for n, _ in trailers:
                if n not in names: names.append(n)
            out += b'trailer: ' + b', '.join(names) + b'\r\n'
        out += b'\r\n'
        if body:
            out += format(len(body), 'x').encode('ascii') + b'\r\n'
            out += body
            out += b'\r\n'
        out += b'0\r\n'
        for n, v in trailers:
            out += n + b': ' + v + b'\r\n'
        out += b'\r\n'
    return bytes(out)
```

```python
def _normalize_host(host: bytes):
    if not host:
        return None
    if host.startswith(b"["):
        return None   # handled elsewhere
    labels = host.split(b".")
    if len(labels) == 4 and all(l and l.isdigit() for l in labels):
        parts = []
        for l in labels:
            if len(l) > 1 and l[:1] == b"0":
                return None
            v = int(l)
            if v > 255:
                return None
            parts.append(str(v))
        return ".".join(parts).encode("ascii")
    if len(host) > 253:
        return None
    for l in labels:
        if not (1 <= len(l) <= 63):
            return None
        for c in l:
            if not (48 <= c <= 57 or 65 <= c <= 90 or 97 <= c <= 122 or c == 45):
                return None
        fc = l[0]; lc = l[-1]
        if not (48 <= fc <= 57 or 65 <= fc <= 90 or 97 <= fc <= 122):
            return None
        if not (48 <= lc <= 57 or 65 <= lc <= 90 or 97 <= lc <= 122):
            return None
    return host.lower()
```

```python
def canonical_authority(raw: bytes, scheme: bytes):
    if not raw:
        return None
    host_part = None
    port_part = None
    if raw.startswith(b"["):
        end = raw.find(b"]")
        if end < 0:
            return None
        inner = raw[1:end]
        rest = raw[end+1:]
        if b"[" in inner or b"]" in inner:
            return None
        if b"%" in inner:
            return None
        try:
            addr = ipaddress.IPv6Address(inner.decode("ascii"))
        except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
            return None
        host_norm = ("[" + addr.compressed + "]").encode("ascii")
        if rest:
            if not rest.startswith(b":"):
                return None
            port_part = rest[1:]
    else:
        if b"[" in raw or b"]" in raw:
            return None
        if raw.count(b":") > 1:
            return None
        if b":" in raw:
            host_part, port_part = raw.split(b":", 1)
        else:
            host_part = raw
        if not host_part:
            return None
        host_norm = _normalize_host(host_part)
        if host_norm is None:
            return None
    port = None
    if port_part is not None:
        port = _parse_port(port_part)
        if port is None:
            return None
    default = DEFAULT_PORTS[scheme]
    if port is not None and port != default:
        host_norm += b":" + str(port).encode("ascii")
    return host_norm
```
